explication: This repository is a Clean Architecture solution template for a todo application, with Angular, React, or API-only variants. The main user path is a browser client navigating protected todo/weather features, reaching ASP.NET endpoints, which dispatch todo commands or queries; the application also models users, roles, and domain events, and persists identity and todo entities through EF Core. The sampled endpoint evidence shows list dispatch, while several feature implementations and endpoint files were not sampled, so those links are omitted rather than inferred.
